settings.heading: Use & care
settings.content: Follow the usage and charging instructions supplied with your fan. Keep the solar panel clean for the best charging results.

settings.heading: Delivery & returns
settings.content:
Your CLIMORA order will be delivered through our courier partner, Aramex. Estimated delivery is 5–10 business days, subject to order processing and courier collection.

See our Shipping & Delivery and Returns & Refunds pages for full details.

settings.title: Rechargeable operation
settings.text: Charge it up and enjoy cordless airflow wherever you need it.

settings.title: Solar charging capability
settings.text: Top up the battery using sunlight — handy for outdoor days and power interruptions.

settings.title: Portable design
settings.text: Easy to move from room to room, or take with you when you head outside.

settings.title: Home & outdoor use
settings.text: Convenient airflow for bedrooms, desks, patios, camping and more.

settings.heading: Airflow that keeps up with you.
settings.text: A rechargeable fan designed for everyday convenience — at home, on the stoep or out for the day.

settings.question: How do I charge SolarFlow?
settings.answer: SolarFlow is rechargeable and has solar charging capability. Please refer to the instructions included with your fan for the charging methods supported and recommended charging times.

settings.question: Can I use it outdoors?
settings.answer: Yes — SolarFlow is designed for portable use at home and outdoors. Avoid exposing it to rain or water unless the product instructions state otherwise.

settings.question: How long will delivery take?
settings.answer: Your CLIMORA order will be delivered through our courier partner, Aramex. Estimated delivery is 5–10 business days, subject to order processing and courier collection.

settings.question: What if I need to return it?
settings.answer: Please read our Returns & Refunds page for eligibility and the steps to start a return.

settings.text: Have a question we haven’t answered? Our team is happy to help.
